attempts.raw: {"risk": 2, "reason": "Fixes a bug (NodeWrongType exception) in a narrowly-scoped Lucene bool query filter parser with added unit tests, but changes loop control flow (break→return) which could subtly alter behavior when multiple filter providers or multiple array items were previously expected to be evaluated in combination."}

reason: Fixes a bug (NodeWrongType exception) in a narrowly-scoped Lucene bool query filter parser with added unit tests, but changes loop control flow (break→return) which could subtly alter behavior when multiple filter providers or multiple array items were previously expected to be evaluated in combination.
